criteria.criterion: Establish a verified post-M057 product-operability baseline and prove reachable existing Program, Harness, runtime, state, operator and test paths.
criteria.result: Brownfield architecture and E2E fixture paths are present and executable, but no dedicated M0058 evidence record is preserved in the supplied archive and no full live operational baseline was demonstrated.
criteria.limitation: Baseline evidence is indirect/documentary rather than a dedicated immutable M0058 execution receipt.

criteria.criterion: Make campaign/program runtime operable from an explicit product control surface without bypassing authority or state-machine semantics.
criteria.result: The governed control-surface test and implementation are present, but test collection fails in this sandbox because psycopg is unavailable; no clean executed proof is available for this criterion.
criteria.limitation: Environment dependency failure prevents execution-level certification of the M0059 control surface.

criteria.criterion: Provide a real, repeatable fixture workspace and test harness with clean deterministic setup, seed data, checkpoints and evidence capture, rejecting mock-only testing.
criteria.result: The dedicated fixture/proof-harness suite executed cleanly: 8 passed.
criteria.limitation: This verifies the harness controls and fixture behavior, not live external runtime availability.

criteria.criterion: Establish an executable typed contract from semantic/production Programs to asset resolution, including duration, role, semantic obligation and rights.
criteria.result: The campaign scope and downstream asset-binding path exist in the repository, and M0064 tests exercise typed production binding, but the supplied archive has no dedicated M0061 certification receipt.
criteria.limitation: No immutable M0061 execution manifest or dedicated test log is available for this archive.

criteria.criterion: Ingest authorized cinematic/archival/owned media into a governed, timestamped, searchable scene corpus with stable boundaries, captions, insert roles and ingest receipts.
criteria.result: The dedicated M0062 corpus suite executed successfully as part of the focused campaign proof run.
criteria.limitation: The certification confirms repository behavior covered by tests; it does not establish authorization of any external production corpus absent supplied real-media evidence.

criteria.criterion: Implement natural-language retrieval over the governed scene corpus with ranked candidates, timestamps, explanations, semantic roles, rights verification and fail-closed abstention.
criteria.result: The dedicated M0063 retrieval suite executed successfully as part of the focused campaign proof run.
criteria.limitation: No real external production media retrieval receipt is present in the archive.

criteria.criterion: Bind selected retrieval candidates into CompositionAssetPack while preserving exact identity, intervals, rights and provenance through executable runtime inputs with tamper-evident lineage.
criteria.result: M0064 focused tests passed within the 56-test integrated focused proof run; M0067 adversarial evidence explicitly proves wrong-source-hash and wrong-scene rejections.
criteria.limitation: Verified lineage controls do not prove a live external retrieval source.

criteria.criterion: Execute the existing video Program against a real OpenChatCut runtime and native timeline, preserving asset identity, source cut ranges and semantic roles with CAE authoritative.
criteria.result: Focused adapter tests pass, but M0067 probed the configured native endpoint and received ConnectionRefusedError; no native EXECUTED receipt was issued.
criteria.limitation: Real runtime execution is not demonstrated in this environment.

criteria.criterion: Make native editing operator-operable within bounds and persist interventions as immutable HumanResolutionEpisode lineage with CAS safety and before/after evidence.
criteria.result: Focused M0066 contract tests pass, but the M0067 live evidence record states that no live campaign/operator execution evidence is available.
criteria.limitation: Native edit propagation, refresh/reopen persistence and CAS behavior are not certified against a live campaign.

criteria.criterion: Execute one clean real campaign and one adversarial campaign end-to-end from semantic intent through retrieval, Program execution, native runtime, operator intervention and release evidence.
criteria.result: Adversarial false-proof controls pass, but the real campaign is BLOCKED: native OpenChatCut is unreachable, real source media is absent, operator evidence is absent, QA/release evidence is absent, and exact Git commit metadata is absent.
criteria.limitation: Cross-boundary production operability cannot be certified from component-level green tests.
